Let’s try ending on a hopeful note for once! I figure it might help you feel a little better after all of the trials and tribulations you have faced here in this Infinite Spring.
lines.zh: 这次我们试着用一个充满希望的调子收尾吧！我想，在你于这个无尽的春天里经历了那么多艰难困苦之后，这也许能让你好受一点。

lines.en: Besides, I need some practice with that as a narrator and {i}you{/i} need some practice with it as a man who’d likely go out of his way to dispose of a box of happiness if it was mistakenly delivered to your door one day.
lines.zh: 再说了，作为旁白我需要练练这个，而{i}你{/i}作为这样一个男人也需要练练——要是哪天幸福被误送到你家门口，你大概会专门绕路去把它处理掉。

lines.en: And that’s super unhealthy, you know! The fact that you’ve made it this far living off of free samples is both a testament to your will and proof that God doesn’t hate you as much you think He does!
lines.zh: 而且这超级不健康，你知道吗！你靠免费试吃活到现在，既证明了你的意志力，也证明了上帝并没有你想的那么恨你！

lines.en: How about finally picking up a membership card though, huh?
lines.zh: 不过，要不要终于去办张会员卡呢，嗯？

lines.en: Something that’ll show all those people handing out the samples that it’s okay for you to have them and that you didn’t just crawl in through a hole in the wall you dug in hungry desperation.
lines.zh: 好让那些发放试吃品的人知道，你可以拿那些东西，你并不是饿得发慌、在墙上挖了个洞才爬进来的。

lines.en: The main issue here is that you’re still kind of unemployed-ish and membership cards can be super expensive, so you’ll have to steal one from someone else.
lines.zh: 主要问题在于你还算是个无业游民，而会员卡可能贵得要命，所以你得从别人那儿偷一张。

lines.en: I can help with that, though! I just need you to click whichever one of the following buttons will help you remember better.

Anyway, now that things are ramping down again, I just want to say I think it’s {i}great{/i} how different things can be based on how they’re presented.
lines.zh: 总之，既然一切又要慢慢收尾了，我只想说，我觉得{i}很棒{/i}的一点是：同样的事情，呈现方式不同，看起来就会完全不同。

lines.en: It’s what’s helped me remain so {i}mysterious{/i} for so long, you know!
lines.zh: 这也是我能一直保持这么{i}神秘{/i}的原因，你知道吗！

lines.en: But the closer we come to an ending we can all be happy with, the more those mysteries (mine included) will fade!
lines.zh: 但我们离那个皆大欢喜的结局越近，那些谜团（包括我的）就越会消散！

lines.en: But with that fading comes something new.
lines.zh: 不过，随着消散而来的，是某种新的东西。

lines.en: Whether it be a new career-
lines.zh: 也许是一份新的事业——

lines.en: : You’re really getting serious about this acting thing, huh?

lines.en: : It’s only a matter of time until Akira loses the job he’s pretending to have. And I don’t want him and Ami going hungry once my reserves dry up.
lines.zh: : Akira 丢掉他那份假装有在上的班只是时间问题。等我的存款见底了，我可不想让他和 Ami 饿肚子。

lines.en: Or a new outlook on life entirely.

lines.en: There will always be people out there willing to support me.
